# Eldritch Master (`features:warlock-eldritch-master`)
**Class:** [Warlock](../classes/warlock.md) | **Level:** [Warlock 20](../levels/warlock-20.md)

When you use your Magical Cunning feature, you regain all your expended Pact Magic spell slots.
